description:

Available on Fridays.
Begin or expand your practice in a beautiful holistic wellness center in South Pasadena.
A wellness collective on Mission Street near the heart of the historic district of South Pasadena is seeking health and wellness professionals to complement its offerings to clients. The space is anchored by an experienced chiropractor who has much experience working within a multidisciplinary arena.
There are 3 chiropractors, 1 acupuncturist, 4 psychotherapists, and a podiatrist within the space who are all cooperative and enthusiastic to be working with other practitioners around.
You'll be able to keep your supplies, books, etc. safely and securely in your treatment space. You'll also have the opportunity to market your services in the physical space itself. We welcome both seasoned and new practitioners.
LOCATION
The building is located on Mission Street, a few blocks south of the Orange Grove exit of the 110, and a few blocks west of the Gold line Metro Stop in South Pasadena.  Trader Joe's is two blocks away.
LOGISTICS
The building has its own parking lot, as well as plenty of free parking within two blocks, is on the ground floor, and you'll have 24/7 access.  Inside: professionally designed reception area, high ceilings, central AC, warm lighting, and ADA compliant restrooms. Most of all: a positive, professional, comfortable environment, with the opportunity to generate referrals with the other healthcare professionals in the space.
RATES
Prices start at $360/month, for 1 day per week.  1 to 7 days a week are available.   Rents include WiFi, utilities, and janitorial services of the common area.  There are a total of 4 treatment rooms in the space as well as a large rehabilitation area, digital x-ray room with x-ray viewing station, and a beautiful reception area.
Please send inquiries through this Craigslist ad. Include your name, the name of your business/practice, and the days of the week that interest you.

title: Seeking Sublet for Bungalow Apartment (1-3 months) starting May 1st (West Hollywood)
address: N. Ogden Drive, West Hollywood, CA 90046
description:
QR Code Link to This Post
Thank you for checking out my post!
I’m seeking a sublet for a cozy bungalow apartment for one to three months starting May 1st for $2795 per month.
This is an exceptionally low price compared to the fees and current higher rates on Airbnb; considering that it is a furnished 1 bedroom bungalow that includes all utilities, including hi speed wifi that tops 400 mbps, Amazon Prime and Netflix. A laundry room is onsite. Also; the home has been custom designed with with love by an artist/carpenter, unlike the scores of white washed condo cookie cutter units that favor starkness over character. And the best part; no elevators or stairs to walk up. Instead you walk through a lush garden into your peaceful oasis, with very friendly neighbors who respect your privacy but still still say hi and smile when you pass by them.
(This is not for someone relocating to Los Angeles with their belongings. It is ideal for a remote worker or someone who is traveling light and is here simply here for work or is considering moving here.)
If you are still interested then read on. :)
________________________________
Details...
Cozy bungalow apartment filled with artwork and custom wood work created by yours truly.
A 5 minute walk to the heart of West Hollywood and all major streets like Santa Monica Blvd., Sunset Blvd., Melrose Ave., including Whole Foods that is around the corner, and Trader Joes that's three blocks away on Sunset Blvd..
The bedroom features a new queen size memory foam bed and pillows with 100% linen comforter; a small but very cool custom made wood office nook for conducting online office work, and a walk in closet that will be completely emptied out for your stay.
The living room features an adjustable sofa and a custom made solid wood dining room table that can double as an office work station.
There are 55” 4K Smart TVs in both the living room and the bedroom.
The bathroom features a large bath and shower, with two adjustable shower heads (one large rain shower above and one adjustable handheld), a water bidet, and an air conditioner to reduce humidity and cool off the bathroom.
The kitchen features a gas stove with new air vent; pots, pans and the full range of amenities like a Bialetti espresso maker, coffee grinder, air fryer, food processor, Ninja blender, microwave, toaster, food compost bin for scraps, and teas, spices, etc.
The outside area features a cool lil tropical garden planted with care by yours truly, along with a Mexican chiminea fire pit.
A street parking permit will be available, if you'll be using a car during your stay.
There is a nominal cleaning fee of $90 for day of departure.
__________________________________
Who I'm seeking...
I am preferably seeking someone who is exceptionally neat, does not drink a lot, nor smoke, and will not invite guests over. (This is important to remember; as allowing other locals into my personal home is something I’m not comfortable with as it's not a stand alone rental - it's my home). In rare instances; you can message me in advance with the name and relationship to the guest that you’d like to invite during the day, if you're long time friends. But I prefer they do not spend the night.
This is more suited for a single occupancy. However if you’re a couple making the inquiry; then the monthly rate will incur an additional charge per night (which is negotiable depending on the circumstances).
In a nutshell; this apartment is suited for a working professional who desires a dedicated workspace along with calm and peace. The neighbors here all know each other and are very helpful if you ever need anything. It's a quiet complex in which everyone lives along side each other harmoniously.
Initial interviews will be conducted over the phone. If the conversation goes smooth then we can then conduct a Zoom/Face-time meeting to finalize.
And finally; I will only respond to emails that include my name in the introduction, and a brief introduction of yourself; what you do, and what brings you to Los Angeles; and most importantly, a phone number I can reach you at. No one under the age of 25 will be considered.
Those with an Airbnb or Linkedin profile will be prioritized.
Cheers!
Michael

A Faraway Paradise
Hidden in Malibu
25 acres off Pacific View Drive, Malibu
If you love nature, serenity, ultimate privacy, wildlife, wildflower blooms, and are an avid bird watcher... this is your dream place in the sun... you can walk to the beach crossing thirteen waterways... fauna and flora every step of the way from hawks to parrots!
Serrano Valley is a gem hidden within the Boney Mountain Wilderness and Point Mugu State Park..lots of bees down in the valley and canyons due to multitude of flowers and  green parrots flying in... Serrano Valley is an amazing place to hike, mountain bike or horse back ride and at night, to star gaze. The trail can be accessed from the East Gate on Serrano Road off Cotharin, from Sycamore Fire Road, from the Sycamore Campground off PCH and even from Encinal Canyon. Keep an eye out for deer and coyote in the coastal sage scrub, hawks and falcons soaring overhead.
Serrano Homesite Trail leads to the property...
This trail travels through Serrano Valley in Point Mugu State Park, the westernmost park of the Santa Monica Mountains. This area is pretty isolated and not well-known so chances are you'll be the only one on it. Nearby Circle X Ranch and the trails of Boney Mountain have more visitors. You will enjoy a peaceful and easy 1.4-mile walk through a rolling grassland meadow with Boney Mountain and Boney Peak in the backdrop. At the homestead site you will get to view old farm equipment and other household items, including the kitchen sink.
There are two natural waterfalls on the property and a year long creek.
Imagine riding out each morning and evening into a sacred valley virtually hidden protected from the hustle bustle of modern life, yes it exists! Because of the location within Serrano Valley there is absolutely no traffic noise...
Imagine living in one of the most beautiful parks in the state and yet be able to drive 34 miles to be in Santa Monica and 43 miles to Wilshire Boulevard via PCH (Highway 1).
Financing available. Senior planner and architect available to assist with permitting and building in record time.

title: Film and Music Industry Dorm Housing ((Downtown LA))
address: 807 S. Flower ST, los angeles, CA 90017
description:
QR Code Link to This Post
30 days for $350, weekly $200, Nightly rentals available at $47/night. Prices include all taxes utilities and fees. We don’t have private apartments; we provide communities to live in (co-living). You share common areas or bedrooms, saving you a lot of money while making life-long friends. Try it out.
Welcome to world's first co-living for people in Film or Music. Artist Housing has consistently been the most affordable housing in Los Angeles for 10 years. Come work on projects with our equipment and amenities. We have everything you need, so you don’t need to leave home!
We have a bed for rent inside spacious shared dorm rooms inside an 8000 sq. ft. facility/100-year-old church in the heart of Downtown LA.  Mainly for people in film and music, but anyone may apply. Although we are in the best part of Downtown (the Financial District) next to the largest skyscrapers, location is not always the most important thing; it is who you live with. Everyone that is accepted into this community is down-to-earth and shares common interests.
Available month to month; just need a 30-day notice before vacating. Meet friends and learn the area quick until you find a more private place to live.
Many people leave making life-long friends and have collaborated on many film and music projects with one another. Before the pandemic, we had events to socialize and network with each other and film or music industry professionals. We have also provided classes and workshops on taking film and music ideas from concepts to final distribution and sales. We hope to do this again soon. All the resources are provided. What you will need is to: collaborate, create, and succeed.
Different beds and rooms to choose from. We have female-only and co-ed bedrooms. Some beds have exclusive access to separate amenities such as private TVs,  privacy curtains, Tempurpedic mattresses, or even a private window to the outside.  Queen-size beds are $50 more per month. If you want to share a bed, we can do rent+half. We also began to include a vanity table for each bed in the female dorms.
Other rooms in the house include a Film and Music Recording Room, a Gym Room, a Theater Room, a Game/Party Room, and even a new Tool and Materials Room to work on arts and crafts. We have teamed up with The Secret Spot Recording Studio to allow our tenants more access to amenities. Everything is free to use. Our latest addition is our Zoom Room, where tenants can join zoom casting calls. We will line up Casting Directors, Talent Managers, and Agents to interview our tenants. We are unaware of anyone else doing this; we figured we needed to pivot our tenant career strategies during the lockdown. We have teamed up with ArtistePro to help us launch such an incredible endeavor.
Here is a video walkthrough of the place: https://youtu.be/h7EmEIM--yg
We know utility services can be pricey and sometimes a headache, so we provided everything a person would need in their home so that their only focus can be improving their careers, such as; cleaning supplies, TP, soaps, iron and ironing board, AAA service, and even communal bicycles. Also included is the fastest internet possible, 1000's 0f internet and satellite channels, including HBO, Cinemax, Netflix, Hulu, and so on. We even have daily cleaning services. There is a washer and dryer on-site, and the maid can do the laundry for you for just $5 bucks per load.
​If you want, you will be added to our community email blast of upcoming events related to film and music and monthly roommate social gatherings. Follow us on social media #ArtistHousing. We also have a Facebook Group called 807 & Friends.
They say location is the top 3 most important things when looking for a place. ONE block away from the red line. Our city block is right across the street from Ralph's AND the new City Target! One block to LA Live and One block to FIDM. For all you late-night artists, the intersection of 8th and Flower is the 24/hr hotspot with 24-hour Subway, 24-hour Ihop, and now 24hr 7/11.  Artist Housing has ranks highest in all location walk scores in all of Los Angeles: https://www.walkscore.com/score/807-s-flower-st-los-angeles-ca-90017
We are usually around the area and can show places on short notice, just give a few hour's heads up via text to
show contact info
and describe what you want to do.
If you can't physically visit the site prior, we can provide as much information online via text, email, or online video walk-through to help you make an informed decision.
Deposits equal one month's rent with utilities. To hold a bed will require half of that deposit upfront. This will make sure you have the bed for your arrival. The sooner, the better, as we are usually pretty full. Unfortunately, the holding deposit is not refundable if you choose not to move in for any emergency or misunderstanding, so please ensure you are certain when you book. Also, the date you reserve cant be adjusted. You'll be able to come later but would have to pay rent as of the day the bed is made available. You pay the remaining half of the deposit and the first month's rent upon moving in.
​We now accept Bitcoin.
With our new Tenant Cloud system, everything can be done on your smartphone, from touring the place and signing the lease to paying the rent and viewing 24/7 live updates of your accounting.

Located in the heart of West Covina, this charming corner lot home sits behind a white picket fence with a lush green lawn, offering classic curb appeal. Inside, a tile entryway leads to a sunken living room with new carpet, a gas fireplace with a brick hearth & mantle, anchored by elegant sconce lighting. Large louvered shutters frame a picture window overlooking the front yard. The dining room, illuminated by a stylish drum shade chandelier, also features large windows with louvered shutters, creating a bright & inviting space. The tile flooring extends to the back of the home, where the open kitchen features granite countertops, a 5-burner gas range, a built-in microwave & a sliding glass door leading to the covered back patio. The patio is an entertainer’s delight, complete with outdoor ceiling fans, tile flooring & a built-in barbecue island. Adjacent to the kitchen, a cozy family room offers a window bench seat & flows into a den with built-in shelving & a ceiling fan. A remodeled 3/4 bathroom is conveniently located nearby, featuring tile flooring, a custom tiled shower with a glass enclosure, recessed lighting & a stylish vanity. Across from the bathroom, the laundry room includes a tiled countertop, washer & dryer hookups & access to the carport, driveway & backyard. The attached 2-car garage is accessible between the laundry & bathroom. Upstairs, new carpet runs throughout the bedroom level. At the top of the stairs, a flex room can serve as a guest room or office. The first bedroom features new LED lighting, brand-new carpet & louvered shutters, while the second bedroom offers similar updates. A 3/4 bathroom serves these rooms & has been updated with tile flooring, a new toilet, a new vanity cabinet with a modern light fixture & a skylight. At the end of the hall, the primary suite is a private retreat with a lighted ceiling fan, sliding glass door opening to a balcony. The ensuite bathroom includes tile flooring, a new vanity light, a linen cabinet, a walk-in closet with sliding mirrored doors, a shower & toilet area & a skylight for added natural light. This spacious home offers multiple living spaces, modern updates & an excellent indoor-outdoor flow, making it perfect for both entertaining & everyday living.

A private bedroom with a small walk-in closet is available in a modern, clean 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment. The living area and kitchen are dark Grey laminate and the bedrooms are newisj carpet. https://www.instagram.com/p/B-aSVRnjDIp/?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=
Full-sized, front-loading Washer/dryer in unit. Side-by-side, garage parking space which is a rare find on the West side.
This building has full amenities. Pool. 2 jacuzzis. Gym. Yoga room. Multiple outdoor BBQs and fire pits.
I am looking for someone laid back, quiet, responsible and respectful. No couples or additional pets please. Someone who doesn't bring the party home. I WFH so would love to find someone with full-time job out of the home.
I'm also looking someone who has taken Covid-19 seriously. I know things are open now but I still am being careful (dining outside when possible, etc.) I definitely want someone who doesn’t bring the party home and guests wouldn’t work with my rescue dog unfortunately.
Utilities run about $100-150/month. We split electricity, gas, water wifi, trash. We can split a cleaning lady once a month which is another $75. Cable is included with the rent. DirecTV is another $7 if you want to add it to your room.
Please, no couples. No smokers, drugs or heavy drinking/partying. If you don't drink at all that's a plus. Looking for someone who doesn't bring the party home. I've always had roommates who basically hang in our rooms but I'd love to find some friendly and sociable people to interact with at home. I'm a very considerate and quiet roommate and am looking for someone who is the same and who can be respectful and keep the common areas clean, share things like keeping the kitchen counters and sink clean, helps taking out the trash, etc. Bonus points if you're a night owl.
This is an amazing location close to freeways, the beach, bike path. You can hear the ocean and sea lions out your window at night. The room is light and bright and gets lots of natural sunlight. This place is a few blocks from the beach.
I would also consider a slightly discounted rent for someone who only needs a place part-time like a pilot or flight attendant.
Must have good credit and be able to sign a one year lease. Looking for someone who works outside the home.
Please message me with any questions and tell me something about yourself. A link to your IG or LinkedIn, Facebook would be great.
As far as me, I have lived in LA for years and enjoy dining out, movies, concerts, travel, baking and seeing friends when it isn't a pandemic. I'm an east coast native too. I identify as she/her.
Please write and tell me a bit about yourself and your situation.
Thanks so much for understanding and for reading all this. I've generally had considerate, kind and friendly roommates over the years and would love to keep that trend going.
